result.summary: Slots a and b are word-for-word the same as in attempt 1. Diffing corr_1 against corr_2 shows changes only in the R rows, so both slots keep their scores. Slot a (E, time contrasts on D) scores novelty 3 / soundness 3. Seeds 5 and 12 are struck, leaving 11. Slot b (N, overnight vs intraday tug of war) scores novelty 4 / soundness 4. Seed 8 is struck, leaving 13. All three R groups score 3 and pass. The head 14 group was revised in substance, not just reworded. The first draft's sort key was a centroid level. It is now replaced by a rank inside the stock's own-norm decile (v1/v2) and by a _lexi with both keys free of level (v3). The residuals against head 4 and head 9 fell from 0.74/0.66 to below 0.22. Two problems remain. First, PI predicted all three variants would sit below 0.5 against head 14 and be added as new heads. The table shows 0.65/0.68/0.52, so they would replace head 14 instead. Second, v2 has a residual of 0.72 against head 13, so it is head 13 with a different input, and I suggest dropping it or changing its window. The head 12 and head 11 groups are unchanged and stay at 3. PI did not take up last round's suggestion to bucket the head 11 variants on volatility, and their volatility exposure is still 0.57/0.56. The head 1 group has been withdrawn.
